hooks.name: world_primitives
hooks.neoforge: RenderLevelStageEvent (lines, boxes, beams and text drawn at the end of the world pass, before the hand)

rust_summary: world primitives (`native_world_primitives`): lines, boxes, beams and text a client mod draws in the world each frame.
doc_summary:
world primitives through `native_world_primitives`: once a frame, a client mod adds lines, box outlines, filled
boxes, beacon-style beams and camera-facing text in world coordinates, each depth tested or seen through walls,
and Horizon draws them after the entities and before the hand ([World primitives](#world-primitives)). Bundles
need `"hooks": @API:world_primitives@`.
